author: ImNotYourTiger
body:
I have been the drama king lately, haven't I.

(Warning to all users. Before I begin, there will be extreme hate and saltiness directed towards certain individuals. If you can not take this, leave while you can)


On with the rant!
So as i've been posting "bullshit" threads, i've noticed quite a few things, and i'm sure everyone else also has. Locking threads (as Eric made a post about it) has been complete bullshit. As staff members lock a thread, they usually do it without warning, or post a comment explaining why this thread will be locked. But why can't we have a say before it's locked. My thread (How long to you spend looking at a screen) was locked due to a flame war, which I didn't want to happen. I think there needs to be a major fix, something that reflects a professional community, not members that want a "Mod" rank next to their name.

Also, some people i've talked to before say staff members don't change after they retire, which is complete bias. As many of you might have seen (before the posts were deleted), a certain retired administrator became salty or butthurt for whatever reason, and decided to start a flame war. Unfortunately, he didn't realize than no one gave 2 shits. There needs to be a better and stronger assessment on players that wish to become staff members. Your attitude reflects your behavior, and as people realize that, they change to become a certain rank they want to be known in. Yet, when they retire, they suddenly morph into an 8 year old girl with daddy issues, which is quite a problem.

The question here is, do people agree that there needs to be a major change in all of this, or is Avicus going to stay as it is, with people being salty and having new rules every 2 weeks?

Note: I do not want to start a flame war. Yes Glitchy, Midnight, and Steven, i'm talking to you. This is somewhere where I want everyone to express their opinions without being criticized for it. If anyone decides that they want to start a flame war, I will not respond. I will simply make sure the post gets deleted, along with any other childish responses.

You know, I just know the first comment is going to be bad xD.
